# Set pieces (generated by `python set_pieces.py --write-docs`; do not edit by hand)

Whole-scene Blender scripts for creature, herd, rider and ship scenes. The dinosaur and ship scripts end with `scene_kit.audit` (skin/skeleton size, action slots, floor contact, subjects in frame) and print `AUDIT ...` lines; an empty audit means clean. Preview with stills or `previs.open_viewer`, never mp4.

## The Last Egg (`last_egg`)

* script: `dino_scene.py`
* story: lion walks to a nest, picks up an egg, is chased by raptors, leaps onto a triceratops and rides through a swamp, a T-Rex roars, the egg is returned to the apatosaurus and glows (50 s, 9 cameras, sound)
* needs: assets/quaternius_dinosaurs_download (CC0 "Dinosaur Animated Pack - Dec 2018" by Quaternius, itch.io; ask before downloading); scenes/ship_assets (python build_ship_assets.py; needs climb, idle, pick, run, jump, sit)
* known limits: the leap is an arc, the rider sits via the Sit clip, no biting or fighting contact
* prompt keywords: `dinosaur|dino\b|raptor|t-?rex|triceratops|apatosaurus|jurassic|prehistoric|volcano.*egg|egg.*volcano`

## The Storm Ship (`storm_ship`)

* script: `ship_scene.py`
* story: lion on a rocking ship climbs the mast, cuts a cloth sail, falls, fights a sea serpent, lightning ends it, calm (60 s, 13 cameras, sound)
* needs: scenes/ship_assets (python build_ship_assets.py)
* known limits: climbing is a walk cycle on a ladder, hands do not grip, serpent is chunky spheres, rain is thin
* prompt keywords: `\bship\b|\bsailing\b|\bpirate|sea serpent|kraken|storm at sea|\bmast\b`

## The Cliff Rescue (`cliff_rescue`)

* script: `cliff_scene.py`
* story: lion free-climbs a cliff on real hand and foot holds, swings across a gap on a rope, climbs on while rocks fall, lifts a cub onto his back and rappels down as the rope frays (62 s, 12 cameras, sound)
* needs: scenes/ship_assets (python build_ship_assets.py; needs the pick clip)
* known limits: rappel feet slide instead of hopping, hands do not wrap the rope, wall is low poly, rocks do not hit the climber
* prompt keywords: `\bcliff\b|rock face|rock climb|free.?climb|rappel|abseil|rope swing|stranded cub|lost cub`

## The Arena (`arena_duel`)

* script: `arena_scene.py`
* story: Leo fights a bigger rival lion in a ruined arena: charge and block, counter jab, grapple, sweep, throw over the shoulder, roar, bow (52 s, 14 cameras, sound)
* needs: scenes/ship_assets (python build_ship_assets.py; needs block, bow, kick, jump, punch, fall, getup, hit, dodge, run, cele)
* known limits: grapple is a bear-hug (arms on shoulders), feet skate in the grapple, impact points are bone-to-bone only (no soft-body)
* prompt keywords: `\barena\b|gladiator|\bduel\b|fights? (?:a |the )?(?:rival|lion)|wrestl|\bgrapple|\bfight scene|boss fight`

## The Great Escape (`great_escape`)

* script: `train_scene.py`
* story: Leo wakes on a speeding prison train, runs the roofs with two guards behind him, jumps the gaps, ducks a gantry, kicks a guard off, turns a brake wheel to release the coupling so the rear cars fall behind, and leaps from a bridge into a river (54 s, 14 cameras, sound)
* needs: scenes/ship_assets (python build_ship_assets.py; needs idle, run, jump, kick, getup, fall, look, cele)
* known limits: ducking is a lean on the run clip, the hands do not grip the rim exactly (they follow rim points), guards use one clip set, interior of the wagons is not modelled
* prompt keywords: `\btrain\b|railway|\bescape\b|prison|train roof|jump(?:s|ing)? (?:between|across) (?:wagons|cars)|chased on|roof of a`

## The Avalanche (`avalanche`)

* script: `avalanche_scene.py`
* story: an avalanche of 270 baked boulders hits a mountain village: Leo warns the 36 cloned lions, saves a lost cub, closes the sliding door of the shelter in time (48 s, 12 cameras, sound)
* needs: scenes/ship_assets (python build_ship_assets.py; needs idle, look, run, climb, pick, cele)
* known limits: the avalanche is boulders and puffs (no snow simulation), the door push is a walk clip with hands on the edge, characters do not react to near boulders
* prompt keywords: `avalanche|landslide|rockslide|village flees|crowd (?:flees|runs)|evacuat|stampede of people|panic`

## The Siege (`siege`)

* script: `siege_scene.py`
* story: an army of 34 cloned lions and 240 troopers besieges a citadel: four catapults breach the wall (54 baked blocks), Leo climbs a ladder, kicks a defender off the wall, turns the winch to raise the portcullis, the army floods in and he hoists the banner (72 s, 14 cameras, sound)
* needs: scenes/ship_assets (python build_ship_assets.py; needs idle, look, run, climb, kick, fall, cele)
* known limits: troopers are cones, the portcullis does not block the crowd physically, arrows are not aimed at actors, no cavalry
* prompt keywords: `siege|castle|citadel|fortress|catapult|battering|storm(?:s|ing)? the (?:wall|gate)|army (?:attacks|storms|marches)|medieval battle`

## The Council (`council`)

* script: `council_scene.py`
* story: six lions argue and decide around a round table: scripted lines with lip sync from syllables, eye lines to the speaker, arm gestures, a scroll passed across the table, a gavel (66 s, generated coverage, voices synthesised from the same syllable times)

* story: Leo sneaks through a moonlit museum past two sweeping flashlight sentries and a blinking laser gate, cracks the pedestal dial, lifts the glass lid, takes the jewel, the alarm sounds and he leaps out of the window (about 50 s; the route is found by a stealth planner and audited frame by frame)

## The Rapids (`rapids`)

* script: `rapids_scene.py`
* story: Leo steers a log raft down a canyon river with a sweep oar: seven boulders, the raft rides the real animated water surface (height, pitch, roll from ray casts), a planner picks the pass side and times the oar strokes (about 36 s)

## Rider on a galloping horse (`rider`)

* script: `rider_scene.py`
* story: rider mounts and gallops, jumps a fence, dust at every hoof, 7 cameras incl. rider point of view (22 s)
* needs: assets/quaternius_farm_animals_download; a built rider scene.blend (lion_source.blend or a quick_review shot)
* known limits: mount is a leap, legs are IK, hands do not wrap the reins
* prompt keywords: `ride[sr]? a horse|riding a horse|rider on|on horseback|horseback|mounts? (?:the|a) horse`

## Lessons (symptom, cause, rule)

| id | symptom | cause | rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| parent_inverse | Animals look thin and deformed ("sticks") once they run; fine in the source file. | Re-assigning mesh.parent in Python resets matrix_parent_inverse. The Quaternius files keep a x3.5 scale in that inverse, so the skin came out 3.5x smaller than its skeleton. | Save matrix_parent_inverse before setting parent and restore it (scene_kit.keep_parent_inverse); copies must copy it too. audit() flags mesh/skeleton size ratios outside 0.55..2.2. |
| gait_speed | Running legs blur into a strobing scribble. | Run clips were played at 1.35..1.9x; they are already fast (a 13 frame raptor cycle is 0.54 s). | Play clips at 0.8..1.2x (stride_play_speed) and derive ground speed from stride length instead of speeding the clip up. |
| action_slots | An action assigned in Python does nothing (static rest pose). | Blender 5 layered actions need a slot: assigning action alone leaves slot None. | Set animation_data.action_slot / strip.action_slot = action.slots[0]. audit() flags strips without a slot. |
| absolute_paths | libraries.load fails with C:\assets\... not found. | Blender -b resolves relative paths against its own folder. | Pass absolute paths to Blender scripts (use pwd -W / Path.resolve()). |
| hidden_templates | Giant dark shapes fill the frame; wrong object is animated. | Template objects hidden with hide_viewport still render; a copy named like its template collides (Triceratops vs Triceratops.001). | Hide templates in viewport AND render and give them a T_ prefix. |
| asset_scene_clutter | A flat plane or grid slices through the scene and hides characters. | Lion asset scenes built by the pipeline contain Floor/Grid/Wall planes that travel with the character group. | Drop meshes named Floor*, Grid*, Wall*, Ceiling*, Rug* and camera/light/empty helpers when loading character assets. |
| climb_pose | Lion climbing looks upside down or lies flat on the mast. | Pitching the body 77 degrees turns the whole body horizontal, not the climbing direction. | Keep the body upright, lean ~0.2 rad into the mast, add rungs; the pipeline has no real climb clip yet (climb_stairs is a walk cycle). |
| floor_contact | A lying or falling character sinks into the floor. | Baked clips drop the hips below the root; foot-lock only handles standing. | Measure the lowest vertex of the largest skin mesh (face parts are static outliers) per frame and lift the root (scene_kit.ground_lift); audit() reports penetration. |
| moving_platform | Characters slide on a rocking ship. | World-space paths on a moving floor. | Parent actors and ship cameras to the platform and key everything in its local space; world cameras aim at an empty parented to the platform. |
| no_clipping | A body that follows its head (serpent) passes through hull, cabin and masts. | Positions come only from a path; nothing pushes them out of scenery. | Run every body point through push_out(p, r, solids) with boxes, cylinders and the hull; this is cheap collision response, use Blender Cloth/Rigid Body only where simulation is the point. |
| cloth | A sail cut loose looks like a rigid card flying. | Keyed rigid plane. | Real Cloth modifier, pin vertex group on the yard, keyframed pin_stiffness 1 to 0 at the cut, wind field with keyed strength, collision on solids, bake the cache before saving. |
| cameras | Camera sits inside a sail or sees only sea. | Camera offsets chosen without looking at moving geometry. | audit() checks at least one subject is in frame mid-cut; render a contact sheet of stills (workbench, 480 px) before reporting. |
| contact_audio | Footsteps and dust do not match the animals. | Constant-rate sound. | Sample foot bone heights per frame, take contacts, and use those times for dust, splashes and sound. |
| no_mp4 | Previews take minutes. | Rendering video. | Never render mp4 for previews; open the .blend with previs.open_viewer (closes earlier viewers) and check stills. |
| downloads | Assets missing on another machine. | Downloaded CC0 packs are not committed. | Ask before downloading, extract into their own new folder, never run code from them, list the pack and licence in the docs (set_pieces.py reports what is missing). |
| user_preferences | Wasted time on renders, stale windows, aimless motion. | Standing preferences of the author. | No mp4 renders (open the .blend); close earlier Blender viewers when opening a new one; no hand or leg motion without a purpose or dialogue; larger rooms and themed props; fix issues by automatic checks, not by hand each time; keep sessions fast and cheap with numeric checks and few images. |
| shared_action | Every horse in a herd runs in lockstep or stands still. | Rig copies share one action. | Call animation_data_clear() on each copy and give each its own NLA strip with a random phase. |
| rider_seat | Rider POV looks at his own face; stirrups and knees inside the horse. | Camera yaw must be heading minus pi/2; stirrup empties placed at the body surface. | Move stirrups outward, tune knee/rein/lean per rider kind (KINDS in rider_scene.py), use IK seat for animals instead of bench Sit clips. |
| dust_scale | Dust puffs look like balloons. | Puff size not tied to the animal. | Size puffs by creature (raptor .18, triceratops .55) and by speed; splashes in water use a blue material. |
| visibility_windows | Characters or props pop in and out or two copies overlap. | Hide keys set on both groups at the same frames. | Use one rig with sequential NLA strips (ship scene) or exact non-overlapping visibility windows (dino scene). |
| grip_ik | Climbing looks like a walk cycle; hands float near holds. | No contact: limbs were never tied to anything. | Place holds procedurally (right hand, left foot, left hand, right foot, step 0.33 m, hand wrist 1.12..1.45 m and ankle 0.26..0.49 m above the root) and IK the forearm and shin bones (chain 2, poles for elbows and knees) to the hold they are planted on; cliff_scene.limb_eval handles hold-to-hold, hold-to-rope and free transitions. The audit measures wrist and ankle bone against the target (limit 7 cm). |
| grip_transitions | Hands or feet miss targets right after a mode change (landing, mounting, turning). | The root keeps moving while a planted foot target is fixed, or the body turns away from a planted target. | Start rising only after a mount crossfade finishes (0.5 s); end plants before the body turns; keep planted targets within 0.4 m of the hip. |
| rigid_bodies | Rocks never fall, or all fall at once. | They rest on a collision shelf; kinematic flag not keyed. | Active rocks start kinematic and get the flag keyed off at their release time; no collider under them; bake with ptcache.bake_all and read the baked positions for impact sounds. |
| pendulum | Rope swing looks arbitrary. | Hand-keyed arc. | Use the exact pendulum: half period pi*sqrt(L/g), amplitude from the start and end x; choose anchor so both ends are reachable and the landing lines up with the next climb column. |
| carry_small_character | A small character appears on a big one without a believable pick-up. | Constraint snap from the slab to the back. | Bake the carried character per frame from the carrier bones: lifted in the right hand (pick clip), held at the chest, then settled on the back over about a second; no constraint, so nothing pops (cliff_scene.cub_pose). |
| release_jump | Letting go of a rope looks like teleporting onto the ledge. | No flight between release and landing. | Release the rope 0.5 s before the end of the swing, play the lion Jump clip fitted around the landing, move the root on a ballistic arc (about 0.45 m high) and plant the feet 0.2 s after the landing. |
| climb_realism | Climbing looks mechanical. | Rigid upright body. | Lean 0.07 rad into the wall and sway the root +-3.5 cm in step with the limb cycle; keep alternating right hand, left foot, left hand, right foot. |
| contact_solver | Punches and kicks stop short of the target or go through it. | Spacing between fighters guessed by hand. | Measure the striking limb at full extension in the evaluated clip, shift the attacker root in x/y by the residual to the target bone over 0.3 s before impact, start the reaction at impact, then re-measure and audit (limit 20 cm; z error remains if the target bone is at another height, so pick the matching bone: chest for a jab, foot for a sweep). |
| body_grip | Grappling hands float beside the opponent. | Fixed IK targets on a moving body. | Make each hand IK target an empty with Copy Location to the opponent shoulder bone and ramp influence 0.5 s in and out; both fighters face each other at 0.62 m and circle about a midpoint. |
| short_loop_strips | NLA strips refuse to be added or overlap. | A loop strip shorter than its clip kept the full clip length. | scene_kit.add_strip trims action_frame_end when the window is shorter than the clip; strips under 0.25 s do not fit the 5 frame blend overlap, merge them. |
| surface_contact | A fist or foot goes inside the other lion. | Targets were bone centres, not the skin. | Aim at the skin: BVH ray from the target bone centre towards the attacker (scene_kit.surface_target, in object space) plus 2 cm; the audit reports penetration (limit 6 cm) and miss (limit 20 cm). The arena strikes now end 9, 3 and 4 cm from the skin. |
| dependency_cycle | Console floods with Dependency cycle warnings; grips jitter. | Two rigs whose IK targets copy the IK-chain bones of each other (arm to arm). | Copy the shoulder bone of the opponent (clavicle) bone TAIL instead; it is not in any IK chain, so there is no cycle. Always grep the log for Dependency cycle. |
| jump_physics | Jumps look floaty or like a hop. | The pipeline Jump clip keeps the feet on the ground (the arc comes from the route), no crouch or tuck. | Apex from flight time (flight_apex = g T^2 / 8), parabola from ballistic(), and jump_profile() for crouch 0.3 s before take-off, stretch, foot tuck by IK (+0.30 m at the top), reach, and a landing dip; flight time 0.7 s gives a 0.60 m apex. |
| crowds | Crowds are either cones or too heavy. | Full characters per spectator are expensive. | Tiers: far rows are simple cones grouped in sections that bob together (12 sections, keyed per frame); the front rows are real animated lions made with clone_character (shared mesh data, own armature, random clip phase via negative strip start, tint per clone): 24 clones evaluate a frame in 0.01 s. For thousands use Unreal Mass or Niagara with a vertex-animation texture, with Blender only authoring the clips. |
| palm_lock | Wrestling or hugging lions merge into one body; hands sink into the shoulders. | Grips aimed at the shoulder bones of a body 0.6 m away. | Palm-to-palm lockup at 1.45 m root spacing: the senior rival wrists go to the midpoint of both root paths (1.2 m high, 0.2 m left and right) and the other lion wrists copy his HAND bones (one-way, no cycle); both lean 0.22 rad. Verify numerically: wrist to target 0 cm, shoulder to wrist 0.37..0.43 m (arm length 0.5). |
| planted_feet | Feet skate during a grapple. | The body moves, the feet follow the root. | plan_feet in arena_scene: IK feet stay where they are and step (0.3 s, 0.1 m lift) only when the body is 0.3 m away, one foot at a time; influence ramps 0.3 s in and out. |
| landing_room | A thrown or fallen character gets up inside the other one. | Landing spot too close. | Land 1.6 m behind the thrower and move the winner 2.5 m away before the loser gets up; the audit checks body-bone distance (limit 10 cm). |
| moving_world | Things on a fast train drift or the scenery moves wrongly. | Mixing train-local and world motion. | Keep the scenery static and key the train (V0 20 m/s after a 4 s ease-in), then compute every character in WORLD space as train x + local x; two groups (front and rear cars) let a coupling release: the rear group decelerates (exponential, k 0.25) so the gap grows by V0*(s-(1-exp(-k s))/k). |
| gap_jumps | Gap jumps are all the same hop or miss the roof. | Take-off and landing chosen by hand. | kit.run_path puts every flight 0.25 m before the gap and 0.35 m after it at constant speed; flight time = distance / speed; arc from flight_apex; strips for jump windows start 0.3 s earlier for the crouch. |
| obstacle_timing | A duck happens where there is no obstacle. | Obstacle placed independently of the fighter. | Place the low gantry at the world x where Leo is at the chosen time (X_BR = train x + local x) and duck when the fighter world x is within 0.5 to 1.6 m of it (pitch 0.6, drop 0.3 m). |
| projectile | A kicked guard slides off sideways like a card. | Keyed position. | kit.ballistic_to(p0,p1,T,t) with T = flight_time_to_ground(z, vz): x,y linear (including the train speed), z a parabola; spin during flight; lie on the ground afterwards with the fall clip and a short exponential slide. |
| kick_apex | The kick solver never reaches the target. | Maximum forward reach of a leg is a low foot. | Measure a kick at the highest foot, a punch at the farthest hand; then the horizontal snap gives 2 cm. |
| roof_floor | Landing from a jump sinks the feet into the roof. | Clip crouch plus the landing dip. | Ground lift (lowest skin vertex against the roof) for every non-airborne frame of all three characters. |
| camera_occlusion | Wagon walls cover the hero in some shots and others show nothing but scenery. | Camera offsets chosen by formula while the train moves. | Run camera_checks (camera inside a solid, subject hidden: 3 heights, 6 samples per cut) and clear_view (automatic: ray from camera to aim, try raise/move candidates, smooth over +-3 keys). In the train scene 245 of 659 camera keys needed fixing. |
| persistence | Props or wall pieces pop in and out of view. | Visibility keyed for convenience (hide_keys on knife, rope, torn sail, sail swaps). | Anything that is ever visible must be visible for the whole film: place it where it belongs from frame 1 (knife in the hand, rope hanging, torn strip behind the sail), animate it instead of hiding it; only short-lived effects (bolts, puffs, splashes, steam, dust) may be hidden. persistence_audit lists violations. |
| crowd_steering | Crowd members overlap, jam at doors or arrive too late. | Pure seek-and-separate steering. | Reynolds steering (alarm delay by distance, seek, separation 1.6 m, avoid stalls, funnel to the opening) plus hard personal space by position correction (0.6 m); arrival when inside and within 1.8 m of the goal; the audit checks spacing >= 0.45 m, that nearly everybody is inside before the slam, and that the last arrival is 1 s before it. |
| measure_then_schedule | A hero race against a simulation is out of sync. | Hero timeline written before the simulation exists. | Bake the simulation first, MEASURE the event time (front reaches the hall: 8th boulder past x), then derive the hero schedule backwards from it (door closes 1 s before, push 4 s, walk in, run, pick-up, run); the audit warns when the derived start is before 1.5 s. |
| zero_length_strips | NLA add_strip fails with no space. | Two schedule entries with the same start and end (a zero-length idle between two back-to-back clips). | Never schedule a strip shorter than 0.25 s; derive schedules from boundaries and drop empty gaps. |
| demolition | A wall hit by catapults only settles by a few centimetres. | Released blocks that stand on the ground do not move; gravity alone does not break a stack. | Release a block at impact time + 0.06 s per metre (radius 3.2 m), release every block above one that has been released 0.35 s later, and kick each block before release (keyframed offset 0.35 to 0.8 m away from the impact and a tilt of up to 0.35 rad while still kinematic) so it starts unsupported. Check by counting blocks moved more than 1 m: 45 of 54 at 22 s. |
| hollow_structures | The hero walks inside solid stone (gatehouse, tower). | Solid boxes for buildings the hero must pass through. | Build passages as pillars and a roof slab, keep towers away from the hero path (the flag pole stands on the wall top at x 27, the tower starts at x 29); the camera audit finds the problem as a subject hidden behind the building. |
| stuck_projectiles | Arrows and stones vanish after landing. | Hidden after the flight. | Projectiles exist from frame 1 (arrow at the archer, stone in the sling) and stay where they land (stone beside the wall, arrow in the ground); only dust puffs are effects. |
| scale_budget | A large battle slows down or is impossible to bake. | Everything modelled as a full character. | 34 real cloned lions (shared mesh) + 240 cone soldiers keyed every 12 frames + 18 clone defenders; 54 baked blocks; 4 catapults x 3 volleys; 54 arrows per volley set; the scene builds in about 100 s and stays interactive. |
| regex_escapes | Keyword routing silently misses prompts. | A backspace character (chr 8) was written where the regex needed backslash-b because of an escaped string in a generated edit. | Check that no file contains chr(8) (tests do), keep regexes in raw strings, and test routing with plain sentences (test_set_piece_routing, test_story_plan_routes_and_warns). |
| long_story | A 10 minute story cannot be built or rebuilt cheaply. | No scene-level plan, cache or assembly. | story_plan (scenes, routing, time of day, warnings) -> build_movie (sequential, parameters in SCENE_PARAMS, reuse by key) -> assemble_movie (linked scene strips plus sound) -> report; see MOVIE_FROM_STORY.md. |
| shared_locations | The same place looks different in two scenes, or is rebuilt every time. | Each set piece built its own environment. | Anything common is built once: locations.py builds a location or prop into bank/<id>_<state>_<params>_<hash>.blend (the hash of that builder invalidates it automatically; props are placed with load_prop; measured saving: train scene 97 s to 29 s) and every scene appends it (locations.load); characters and clips already come from shared files (ship_assets). Scene state (intact, buried, breached) is a parameter, and story_plan carries damage from scene to scene and warns when a set piece cannot show it. |
